why: A UIUC talk (Feb 2025) by Xuerui Yang and Xiaochun Li reports an improved bound on the classical divisor problem's own exponent, pushing below Huxley's long-standing 131/416 (~0.3149) to about 0.314483, via the Bombieri-Iwaniec method; this is exactly the quantity Δ(x)=O(x^θ+ε) the k=1 bullet concerns.
